title: Launch description
description: One single-player battle for the engine's --launch option to fly.

side.description: rebel or imperial for training, combat and campaign; none for the rest.

mission.description: folder/file as the game's own list names it; a sequence's file for a tournament, battle or campaign.

pilot.description: A pilot the game already has: 1 to 12 letters, digits, spaces, underscores, hyphens or dots, starting and ending with a letter or digit, holding none of the flight switch words.

result.description: Where the engine writes the result file; beside the description when left out.

seed.description: The random seed a sequence starts from; the engine draws one when left out.

ai_program.description: The AI program the engine starts to decide what computer craft do; no computer craft decides anything when left out.

python.description: The Python that runs the AI program.

path.description: The AI program's path, as the Python is given it.

settings.description: Settings of the game's solo screen; one left out keeps the game's own value.
